title: Ledger Account With Custom Errors

visible.label: Valid deposits and withdrawals track balance and history
visible.script:
acc = Account("Ops", 100)
assert acc.owner == "Ops"
assert acc.deposit(50) == 150
assert acc.withdraw(30) == 120
assert acc.balance == 120

visible.label: Overdraft raises InsufficientFundsError without changing balance
visible.script:
acc = Account("Ops", 40)
try:
    acc.withdraw(75)
    assert False, "Expected InsufficientFundsError"
except InsufficientFundsError:
    pass
assert acc.balance == 40

hidden.label: Negative or zero initial balance rejected with ValueError
hidden.script:
try:
    Account("Ops", -10)
    assert False, "Expected ValueError"
except ValueError:
    pass
acc0 = Account("Zero")
assert acc0.balance == 0

hidden.label: Non-positive deposit raises ValueError
Non-positive withdrawal raises ValueError
InsufficientFundsError inherits from Exception/ValueError
hidden.script:
assert issubclass(InsufficientFundsError, Exception)
assert isinstance(InsufficientFundsError("low"), Exception)

hidden.label: Exact full balance withdrawal zeroes account cleanly
hidden.script:
acc = Account("Clear", 200)
assert acc.withdraw(200) == 0
assert acc.balance == 0

hints: Define class InsufficientFundsError(ValueError): pass (or subclass Exception).
Check amount <= 0 BEFORE comparing amount > self.balance in withdraw(), raising ValueError for bad amounts and InsufficientFundsError for overdrafts.
